column3: “a company of peoples” renders “an assembly (qahal) of peoples.”
“to my sorrow” renders “upon me (to my grief).”
“I never expected” renders “I did not judge (think).”
“Joseph took them both” is supplied with the subject; NASB adds “toward” to clarify the positions.
“crossing his hands” renders a verb that may also mean “guiding his hands wisely.”
“has been my shepherd” renders “who has shepherded me.”
“may my name live on in them” renders “may my name be called in them,” and “grow into a multitude” renders a verb related to “fish.”
“a multitude of nations” renders “the fullness of the nations” (end of the verse).
“By you Israel shall pronounce blessing” renders “By you Israel will bless.”
“one portion” renders “one shoulder (shekem),” which may be a play on the place name “Shechem.”
